Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent
Enclosing class:
DryGasSealVentStudy
public static final class DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent extends Object
An installed vent assembly at fixed receiving conditions. Each row gives cavity pressure and simultaneous flows to the intended vent and, optionally, through the separation seal to the bearing housing.

  • Method Details

    • fromGasPipe

      public static DryGasSealVentStudy.Vent fromGasPipe(SystemInterface gas, double receiverBara, double equivalentLengthM, double boreM, double roughnessM, double[] massRatesKgS)
      Rates a horizontal, constant-bore gas line using the isothermal pressure-squared equation, receiver gas properties and the Darcy friction factor used by AdiabaticPipe. Flashes an owned copy at each rating pressure. The low-Mach approximation excludes choking, phase changes, heat transfer and varying gas composition.
      Parameters:
      gas - vent gas at the rating temperature, for example a process stream's thermodynamic system
      receiverBara - fixed absolute outlet pressure in bara
      equivalentLengthM - pipe and fittings equivalent length in metres
      boreM - inside diameter in metres
      roughnessM - absolute wall roughness in metres
      massRatesKgS - strictly increasing rating points starting at zero, in kg/s
      Returns:
      vent characteristic at this receiver pressure and gas composition
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for unsupported gas states, geometry or outlet Mach above 0.3
